question: Which goddess situated by name protects the Brahma aperture at all times?
premises: The locus to be protected is the Brahma aperture
Mātaṅgī is the deity situated there by name
inference: Mātaṅgī, situated by name, always protects the Brahma aperture.
plain_english: May Mātaṅgī, situated there by name, always protect the Brahma aperture.
